author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Tune (1/N): Batch-Robust HVGs (n=1500) + SOTA
abstract: Following the successful synergy test (ID 1261, score 0.7441), this experiment begins a systematic exploration of the Batch-Robust HVG selection method. It tests a more stringent selection by reducing the per-batch `n_top_genes` from 2000 to 1500 before taking the intersection. The goal is to optimize the feature set for the SOTA pipeline.
